scope: Actual browser UI, real local application server, loopback synthetic proxy and translation service; no corporate credentials or paid API
checks: Invalid proxy URL is rejected with a readable error and retains typed fields
Saving preserves edited document text, model name, API mode and reasoning selection
Successful save clears the password input and indicates stored credentials
A translation started from the UI uses the newly saved proxy without restarting
A fresh browser tab restores URL, empty NO_PROXY, local-use selection and saved-password indicator
Saved password is never filled into the browser input
Explicit password removal updates the UI to no saved password
